name: scroller
title: Scroller
description: A row (or column) of items that glides past on a loop: logos of the organisations you work with, short quotes, headlines. The items are real content, so the component treats them that way first and as motion second.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/scroller

Installed to `components/ui/effects/scroller.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/scroller';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/scroller

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
